meta.title: Ba Na Hills Complete Travel Guide 2026 | Golden Bridge, Tickets, Rides & Tips
meta.description:
Planning a visit to Ba Na Hills from Da Nang? This complete Ba Na Hills travel guide covers everything you need to know before visiting Sun World Ba Na Hills in Vietnam.

We visited Ba Na Hills at the end of May and explored the Golden Bridge, French Village, Moon Kingdom, Fantasy Park, Lunar Castle, gardens, temples, live shows and the Alpine Coaster.
In this video, we cover:

• How to reach Ba Na Hills from Da Nang
• Distance and travel time from Da Nang city
• Why you should book a cab in advance
• Best time to reach and avoid crowds
• Ba Na Hills ticket prices in INR and USD
• Booking tickets through Klook
• What to carry for unpredictable mountain weather
• Golden Bridge and Le Jardin D’Amour
• Moon Kingdom and Lunar Castle
• French Village and Sun Kingdom
• Fantasy Park rides and indoor attractions
• Alpine Coaster price and experience
• Live shows and performances
• Food and restaurant options
• Whether staying at Mercure Ba Na Hills is worth it
• The best route to cover Ba Na Hills in one day

Ba Na Hills is located around 25 to 30 kilometres from central Da Nang and is one of the most popular day trips in Vietnam. Reaching early, wearing comfortable shoes and carrying a rain cover can make your experience considerably better.

Our Klook booking for three adults cost ₹9,037.92, which was approximately ₹3,013 per person. Prices may vary depending on the date, package and exchange rate.

Watch the complete video before planning your Ba Na Hills trip.
